{"summary": "Document the API including the QR endpoint.", "files": [{"path": "README.md", "content": "# URL Shortener

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/links` | Create a short link (`{ "url": "...", "alias": "optional" }`) |
| GET | `/{code}` | Redirect to the long URL (302) |
| GET | `/api/links/{code}/stats` | Link statistics |
| GET | `/api/links/{code}/qr` | QR code for the short link (`image/png`) |
| GET | `/health` | Health check |

QR codes encode the public short URL (`Shortener:BaseUrl` + code), so a printed code keeps working
even if the link's target changes.
